global: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern, dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork, and pale yellow menma are served on a warm wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface with faint residue inside.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly crispy, browned surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their curved, elongated surface.
